status: Conservative component-envelope sensitivity, not accepted concurrent load combination

seat_envelope.basis: Full effective flat weldgroup; no directionalstrengthbonus. Load cases are analyst comparisons, not approvedcodecombinations.

limitations: Independent maxima deliberately combined; does not define operating spectrum
Rigid collar redistribution assumed; 3/8 face local bending and 1/4 bottom plate bending/contact with C5 track are unresolved
Parent HSS local stress, chord stress and global body crossmember capacity are unresolved
Neighbor rail loads and other vehicle loads are not included
6 mm sidegusset root weld checked separately; its local load introduction into collar face is not covered by this average-transfer screen
